Our pillars

Three pillars, one market.

Each pillar has its own thesis. Together they describe one market that is being rebuilt.

01 Fintech The rails that move money Payments and stablecoins, wallets and exchanges, lending and credit, and tokenized real-world assets. Explore 02 Blockchain Infrastructure for an open economy Base layers and scaling, decentralized infrastructure, and consumer apps and games. Explore 03 AI Intelligence as infrastructure Decentralized compute and models, AI agents, and applied AI in health and consumer. Explore

What we look for

Five questions we ask first.

  1. 01

    Domain depth

    Founders with deep knowledge of their market, who ship quickly and learn faster.

  2. 02

    Proof of demand

    A real problem, with evidence that people want it solved: users, revenue, pilots or letters of intent.

  3. 03

    Durable economics

    A business model, and a token model if there is one, that works without relying on the token price.

  4. 04

    Regulatory maturity

    Regulation taken seriously from day one, especially in payments, lending and tokenized assets.

  5. 05

    Essential technology

    Fintech, blockchain or AI that is essential to the product, not decoration.

Our approach

How we work with founders.

01

Conviction, not consensus

We form our own view of a market, and we move with conviction when we find the right team.

02

Hands-on from day one

Our investments come with access to our incubation team, from strategy and token design to technology and go-to-market.

03

Aligned for the long term

We back business models built to last, and we stay involved as companies grow.
